question: At the 2025 household water tariff, which district's households paid more for water per resident in 2025, Harrowfield or Ossbridge, and by how many tenge per resident?

tool_calls.name: lookup
tool_calls.arguments: {"query": "Nine Rivers Region 2025 household water tariff Harrowfield Ossbridge population household water use 2025"}

matches.title: Household water tariff
matches.text: From 1 January 2025 the regional household water tariff is 142.35 tenge per cubic metre, in every district. The 2024 tariff was 131.80 tenge per cubic metre. One megalitre is 1,000 cubic metres. The tariff is charged on household use only.

matches.title: The Nine Rivers Region - about these profiles
matches.text: The Nine Rivers Region is a fictional region made up for this homework. It has twelve districts: Ossbridge, Ossford, Tarnvale, Kelmarsh, Brightwater, Stonecairn, Harrowfield, Lindenmoor, Redfen, Ashgrove, Millbrook, Coldharbour. Each district has one profile. Unless a figure says otherwise, population is from the 2025 census, budgets are for the 2025 fiscal year, and water use is household water use over calendar year 2025. Profiles marked ARCHIVED were published in 2019, are kept for reference only, and have been superseded. Corrections to published profiles are issued as separate notices and take precedence over the profile they correct.

matches.title: Brightwater district profile (2025)
matches.text: Brightwater has 17 schools, which enrolled 6,241 pupils for the 2025/26 school year. The district, founded in 1889, stretches along the Bright over 912.4 square kilometres and keeps 455.0 km of paved road. Census population: 39,902 in 2020 and 44,675 in 2025. Households used 3,315 megalitres of water during 2025, and the district's 2025 budget amounted to 7,733.9 million tenge.

matches.title: Ossbridge district profile (2025)
matches.text: Founded in 1871 on the Oss, Ossbridge covers 1,284.6 square kilometres. Its budget for 2025 was set at 9,284.5 million tenge. Household water use in 2025 came to 3,862 megalitres. There are 21 schools in the district, attended by 7,413 pupils in 2025/26. The 2025 census recorded 52,904 residents; the 2020 census had recorded 48,317. The district's paved road network is 612.4 km long.

matches.title: Harrowfield district profile (2025)
matches.text: Founded in 1862 on the Harrow, Harrowfield covers 1,388.5 square kilometres. Its budget for 2025 was set at 16,021.7 million tenge. Household water use in 2025 came to 7,146 megalitres. There are 36 schools in the district, attended by 13,904 pupils in 2025/26. The 2025 census recorded 90,212 residents; the 2020 census had recorded 83,609. The district's paved road network is 1,037.2 km long.
